accessed.whyNeeded: BooksCorpus supplies 800M of BERT's 3.3B pre-training words and is the whole of GPT's corpus. What it contains and how it was assembled bears on the claim that a document-level corpus is critical, on the BERT/GPT data difference in A.4, and on reproducing pre-training.

The SQuAD 1.1 result includes a first fine-tuning stage on TriviaQA, specified only as TriviaQA-Wiki paragraphs made from the first 400 tokens of documents containing a possible answer. Reproducing that stage, or judging how much supervision it adds beyond the reported 0.1-0.4 F1, needs the dataset's distant-supervision construction.
